/home/eric/vm/qemu-scripts/vm_ssh.sh 'python3 -c '"'"'import base64,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,sys
x=json.load(sys.stdin);rows=x['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'files'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'];result=[]
for row in rows:
 p=pathlib.Path(row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'guest'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']);data=base64.b64decode(row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'data'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'],validate=True)
 assert p.is_absolute() and str(p)==row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'guest'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'] and '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'..'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'not in p.parts
 assert (p.is_relative_to('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'/tmp'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"')and p!=pathlib.Path('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'/tmp'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'))or str(p)in x['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'data_files'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']
 assert p.parent.is_dir() and p.parent.resolve()==p.parent and not p.is_symlink()
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'sha256'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'] and len(data)==row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'bytes'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']
 if p.exists():assert p.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'sha256'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']
for row in rows:
 p=pathlib.Path(row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'guest'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']);existed=p.exists()
 if not existed:
  with p.open('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'xb'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"')as f:f.write(base64.b64decode(row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'data'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'],validate=True));f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
  fd=os.open(p.parent,os.O_DIRECTORY);os.fsync(fd);os.close(fd)
 assert not p.is_symlink()and p.is_file()and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'sha256'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']
 result.append(dict(guest=str(p),sha256=row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'sha256'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'],bytes=p.stat().st_size,status='"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'retained-identical'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'if existed else'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'uploaded-new'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'))
for row in rows:assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'guest'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'sha256'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']

'"'"''
